description: Top drugs by government spending — Rank drugs in a government program for the latest CMS data year: program=partd (default) | partb | medicaid, sort=spending (default) | claims | beneficiaries | cost-per-claim | unit-cost-growth | spending-growth, n=1-50 (default 25). Each row has spending, claims, beneficiaries, average spend per claim and per unit, 1-year spending change and unit-cost change. Non-spending sorts rank within the 500 highest-spending drugs; unit-cost-growth skips CMS outlier years. Source: CMS Spending by Drug datasets, data.cms.gov (US government, public domain). Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: health_top_drugs
